name: Trail Charm
flavor: A knotted cord every explorer ties before the first long walk.

name: Patch Band
flavor: Mended so often that it is mostly patches, and tougher for it.

name: Quick Trinket
flavor: A tiny bell that never rings but somehow makes feet lighter.

name: Fortune Charm
flavor: Found in the pocket of a coat nobody remembers owning.

name: Keen Trinket
flavor: A bright sliver of something sharp, wrapped in thread.

name: Tidepool Charm
flavor: A shell that keeps a little pool of seawater in it, always.

name: Wave Band
flavor: Woven from kelp that moves as if the tide were still in.

name: Pearl Trinket
flavor: A pearl that hums quietly whenever a storm is far away.

name: Cinder Charm
flavor: A coal that stays warm in the coldest pocket.

name: Forge Band
flavor: Hammered flat on a forge that was left running overnight.

name: Phoenix Trinket
flavor: A single feather that is a little too hot to hold for long.

name: Mossy Charm
flavor: Soft with moss, and a small fern grows from it in spring.

name: Bark Band
flavor: A ring of bark that tightens a little when danger is near.

name: Heartwood Trinket
flavor: Carved from the oldest tree in the grove, which did not mind.

name: Static Charm
flavor: Crackles when you rub it on wool, and sometimes when you don't.

name: Volt Band
flavor: A copper loop that taps out a rhythm against the wrist.

name: Storm Trinket
flavor: A glass bead with a small thundercloud trapped inside.

name: Festival Lantern Charm
flavor: A paper lantern charm, lit once a season at the Festival of the tide.

name: Festival Hearth Band
flavor: A warm band given to everyone who stood by the Festival hearth.
